visual.general_description: Twelve-lead ECG tracing on a grid with a long lead-II rhythm strip.
visual.detailed_description: One unlabeled whole ECG image contains three rows of four short tracing segments, labeled I/aVR/V1/V4, II/aVL/V2/V5 and III/aVF/V3/V6. A long II strip spans the bottom. The background has fine pale pink/brown squares with darker major gridlines. Thin black waveform traces contain repeated sharp complexes; V4–V6 show prominent tall narrow upward spikes. Rectangular calibration pulses appear at the left of the first and long rhythm rows. No heart-rate, QT/QRS interval, paper-speed or voltage-gain number is printed.

visual.detailed_description: A horizontal grayscale triptych shows dark curving branching vascular profiles over mottled heart/torso backgrounds. The left view has a long hooked vessel arching down and inward with small branches. The middle has a long downward-curving main profile with thin branches and a dense superior bifurcation. The right has multiple winding branches from a superior central vascular junction. Thin device profiles and faint rib/spinal outlines are visible. No panel letters, vessel-name labels, arrows, ruler or printed stenosis measurement appears.
